description:
Cast Clash of the Eikons by paying {G}, removing a lore counter from Esper Terra and then putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's first, second or third chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Summon: Esper Valigarmanda, and then choosing to put a lore counter on the token.
The Summon: Esper Valigarmanda token's first and second chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling Clash of the Eikons from your graveyard and an instant or sorcery from each opponent's graveyard.
Resolve the second trigger, adding {R}{R} and causing you to pay {1} to cast Clash of the Eikons from exile.
Resolve Clash of the Eikons, removing a lore counter from Esper Terra and then putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Terra, Magical Adept // Esper Terra
uses.cardState: as Esper Terra with three or fewer lore counters on it
